guidelines.title: Auto Underwriting — Driver Risk Tiers (Sample)
guidelines.content:
Fictional underwriting guideline for illustration only.

                        Risk Tier A (Preferred, fictional criteria):
                        - 0 at-fault accidents in past 5 years
                        - 0 moving violations in past 3 years
                        - Continuous prior coverage of 3+ years

                        Risk Tier B (Standard, fictional criteria):
                        - 1 at-fault accident in past 5 years
                        - Up to 2 moving violations in past 3 years

                        Risk Tier C (Non-standard, fictional criteria):
                        - 2+ at-fault accidents in past 5 years, or
                        - A lapse in prior coverage exceeding 30 days

                        Referral to fictional senior underwriter required for any risk
                        involving a DUI/DWI conviction in the past 7 years (illustrative only).

guidelines.title: Homeowners Underwriting — Property Risk Factors (Sample)
guidelines.content:
Fictional underwriting guideline for illustration only.

                        Factors considered (fictional, illustrative weighting):
                        - Roof age (roofs older than 20 years fictional-flagged for inspection)
                        - Distance to fire hydrant / fire station
                        - Prior claims history (2+ water-damage claims in 5 years fictional-flagged)
                        - Presence of a swimming pool (may require fictional liability rider)
                        - Construction type (frame vs. masonry, fictional rate factor)

                        Coastal/high-wind fictional zones may require a separate wind/hail
                        deductible endorsement, consistent with common state-specific practice
                        (described here only in general terms, not as authoritative guidance).

guidelines.title: Life Underwriting — Risk Classification (Sample)
guidelines.content:
Fictional underwriting guideline for illustration only.

                        Risk classes (fictional, illustrative):
                        - Preferred Plus: non-smoker, no chronic conditions, BMI within
                          fictional target range, favorable fictional lab results.
                        - Preferred: non-smoker, minor well-controlled fictional condition.
                        - Standard: one or more moderate fictional risk factors.
                        - Table Rated: elevated fictional risk factors requiring a premium
                          multiplier (fictional tables, e.g. Table 2 = +25%).

                        Applications with a face amount above a fictional threshold
                        (e.g., $250,000 in this sample) are routed to fictional medical
                        underwriting review, which may request a fictional paramedical exam.
